title: How do I log in to the AX Portal?
description:
Login Instructions

To access the AX Portal, follow these steps:

  1. Open the AX Portal website.
  2. Click the Login button.
  3. Enter your registered email address and password.
  4. Click Sign In.

After successful authentication, you will be redirected to your dashboard.

title: How can I reset my password?
description:
Password Reset Process

If you forget your password, you can request a password reset.

  1. Open the login page.
  2. Click Forgot Password?.
  3. Enter your registered email address.
  4. Follow the password reset instructions sent to your email.
  5. Create a new, secure password.

Security Tip: Never share your password reset link or verification code.

title: How do I update my profile information?
description:
Updating Profile Details

You can update your personal information from your account settings.

  1. Sign in to the AX Portal.
  2. Navigate to Account Settings.
  3. Select Edit Profile.
  4. Update the required information.
  5. Click Save Changes.

Your updated information will appear in your profile after the changes are saved successfully.

title: How can I submit a form through the portal?
description:
Form Submission Guide

Follow these instructions to submit a form:

  1. Open the Forms section.
  2. Select the required form.
  3. Complete all mandatory fields.
  4. Upload supporting documents if required.
  5. Review the entered information.
  6. Click Submit.

Make sure all information is accurate before submission.

title: What file formats are supported for document uploads?
description:
Supported Document Formats

Supported file formats depend on the requirements of the selected form.

  • PDF: Documents and reports
  • JPG/JPEG: Scanned images and photographs
  • PNG: Images and screenshots

Always verify the permitted file formats and maximum file size shown in the upload field before submitting.

title: How do I contact the support team?
description:
Getting Support

If you experience problems while using the portal, you can contact the appropriate support person.

  1. Open the Point of Contacts section.
  2. Find the relevant department or support contact.
  3. Review the available contact information.
  4. Contact the person using the provided communication channel.

When reporting technical problems, include a clear description of the issue.

title: Where can I find company policies and guidelines?
description:
Accessing Policies and Guidelines

The AX Portal provides a dedicated section for organizational policies, memos, and guidelines.

  1. Sign in to the portal.
  2. Open the Policy Memos & Guidelines section.
  3. Browse the available documents.
  4. Select a document to read its contents.

Review the latest applicable version before following any policy or procedure.

title: How can I view upcoming events?
description:
Viewing Calendar Events

The portal calendar displays scheduled events, meetings, and important dates.

  1. Open the Calendar section.
  2. Select the required month or date.
  3. Click an event to view available details.

Event details may include the title, date, time, location, and description.
